title: Constructible complete reconstruction in one degree
statement: Let T be a Noetherian finite-type scheme over a field, d an adic coefficient datum, M an adic tower and W common uniform local models on a stratification S with lower=upper=q0. Assume every level has intrinsically constructible coefficient cohomology and vanishes away from q0. Then the actual uniformReconstructionLimit is bounded constructible complete, its canonical projection-induced counits are isomorphisms compatible with every quotient normalization, and its cohomology vanishes away from q0. Uses [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete].

source.place: Step 2, common local models, normalized finite tower and adic reconstruction

proof.text: Apply reconstructionUniformTower to the supplied common W. It returns intrinsic completeness, invertible actual counits, all comparable-pair normalization squares and the model bounds.

Use finite generation of the ideal to choose its finite generating family. The proved wfPresentation_of_complete transfers intrinsic completeness to the complete-category presentation. Transport constructible cohomology and the equal level bounds to the actual reductions along the canonical counit isomorphisms. The proved boundedConstructible_of_reductionControl supplies compatible etale origins and constructible completeness.
The common lower and upper model bounds both equal q0, so reconstruction bounds imply all other cohomology objects are zero.

theorem singleDegreeUniformReconstruction
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (fT : T ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hT : LocallyOfFiniteType fT ∧ QuasiCompact fT)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower T d) (S : Stratification T) (W : UniformAdicTowerData d M S)
    (q₀ : ℤ) (hlower : W.lower = q₀) (hupper : W.upper = q₀)
    (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      @IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf T (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) _
        (d.quotientFinite n)
        ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison T d n).hom).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n))))
    (hz : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), q ≠ q₀ →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n))) :
    PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T d (uniformReconstructionLimit d M) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (uniformReconstructionCounit d M n)) ∧
    (∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b),
      (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d b a hab)).map
          (uniformReconstructionCounit d M b) ≫ (M.normalization b a hab).hom =
        (pbcReductionNormalization (pbcAdicProjection T d b)
          (pbcAdicQuotient T d b a hab) (pbcAdicProjection T d a)
          (pbcAdicProjection_comp T d b a hab)
          (uniformReconstructionLimit d M)).hom ≫ uniformReconstructionCounit d M a) ∧
    ∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ q₀ → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      (uniformReconstructionLimit d M))
